description: Check whether a rumor, headline, claim or link (X/TikTok/YouTube post, article) is being reported by real newsrooms. Compares it with what 37 newsrooms (BBC, NYT, Fox News, NPR, Guardian, CBS, NBC and more) are reporting now and have reported since November 2026, flags satire sites and old news, and returns a verdict, the matching coverage with links, and a public answer page. Use when a user asks "is this real?", "is this fake news?", or shares a link to check. It reports coverage; it is not a fact-check.

claim.description: The claim in plain words, a headline, or a link to check.

name: check_claim
title: Is it real?
